note: Default L anchors for the 11-step neutral ramp. Chroma ceiling is 0.02 for tinted neutrals, 0 for true grey. Hue is inherited from the brand's neutral tint (if any) or set to 260° (slightly cool) by default.
chromaDistribution: peaks at mid lightness (L=0.5), decays toward both ends
invariants: L is monotonic decreasing from step 0 → step 1000
Adjacent-step ΔL ratio stays within 1.0–1.5x (excluding 0↔50 and 950↔1000)
Hue is constant across the ramp
